claim: Try it with sample data opens a seeded listening sheet and keeps it separate from your files.
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /?demo=1; asserts the seeded player, demo banner, and demo: IndexedDB namespace

claim: Files stay in this browser and the sample flow makes no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: fresh demo context records every browser request and asserts each is same-origin

claim: Saved sheets reopen offline after the first visit.
sandbox: open the demo, wait for its service worker, set the context offline, and reload the sample player

claim: The player highlights the timed phrase at the current playback position.
sandbox: set the shipped sample audio to 2.5 seconds and assert its second cue is active

claim: The player opens timed VTT or SRT captions beside local audio.
sandbox: enter from the demo, leave it, and open a generated local WAV with a timed SRT file

claim: Reading text can be set from 18 to 30 pixels.
sandbox: use both size controls on the shipped sample and assert the 18 px and 30 px limits
search the shipped sample for a unique phrase and assert one visible result

claim: Listeners can bookmark a playback position.
sandbox: set the sample player position, activate Bookmark here, and assert the new marker

claim: Position export contains bookmarks and no audio bytes.
sandbox: export the shipped sample, inspect the download, and assert the position record has no audio data

claim: Unreadable audio produces a recovery message instead of an unusable player.
sandbox: enter from the demo and submit non-audio bytes named .mp3 with a valid VTT

claim: Malformed position JSON explains which file to choose.
sandbox: upload malformed JSON to the sample player and assert the actionable message

claim: Pocket Plus is an optional US$12 one-time license for appearance controls.
sandbox: open the product and assert the stated price, one-time purchase wording, and checkout link
